visible_blocks.name: decision_summary
visible_blocks.rule: Answer purchase intent quickly; no generic filler.

visible_blocks.name: specifications
visible_blocks.rule: Use only verified product data; unknown stays unknown.

visible_blocks.name: suitable_not_suitable
visible_blocks.rule: State fit and limits only when supported by product/project evidence.

visible_blocks.name: compatibility
visible_blocks.rule: Size alone is insufficient; connection/standard/pressure must be checked.

visible_blocks.name: shipping_returns
visible_blocks.rule: Link or state only current verified policy; never invent promises.

visible_blocks.name: real_media
visible_blocks.rule: Real product media is evidence; AI media is illustrative only.

visible_blocks.name: reviews_qa
visible_blocks.rule: Only genuine customer evidence; generated Q&A must be labeled/generated and held for review.

publication_rule: Content improvements may be written to published products only when they do not invent technical/commerce claims and preserve IDs, SKU, categories, stock, price and existing content.
